verdict.reasons: Core product identity is clear: the upright white-and-blue cylindrical roll is readable as AFP Drip Irrigation Tape, with accurate sleeve captions and the required AFP | 09134922013 watermark. The installed lines are technically consistent with drip tape laterals for the stated agronomy intent, and the neutral seedlings/greenhouse setting matches the scene requirements. Minor advisory issues only: a few small secondary caption elements on the roll show slight AI rendering artifacts rather than clean typography, and the foreground crop framing is tight, but neither causes a core defect.

focused_physical_review.reason: A distinct black irrigation line is visible directly behind the right side of the package; it emerges from behind the cylinder on the same horizontal axis, meaning the line crosses the package footprint rather than leaving a broad uninterrupted gap. There are no visible protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails emerging from the carton. There is exactly one white-and-blue AFP package, and while it contains a roll of tape, there are no additional distinct loose product coils or uninstalled rolls outside of the package.
